thread.title: Sports Broadcast Schedule

author: The Associated Press
title: Sports Broadcast Schedule
text:
• AFL: Melbourne at Collingwood at 2 a.m. (Friday) on FS2.
• CFL: Winnipeg at Montreal at 4:30 p.m. on CBSSN.
• College Soccer (Men's):
•   - Ohio St. at Virginia Tech at 3 p.m. on ACCN.
•   - Providence at Rutgers at 3:30 p.m. on BTN.
•   - Maryland at Wake Forest at 5 p.m. on ACCN.
• College Soccer (Women's):
•   - Ohio St. at South Carolina at 4 p.m. on SECN.
•   - TCU at Iowa at 5:30 p.m. on BTN.
• Golf:
•   - LPGA Tour: The CPKC Women’s Open, First Round at 6 a.m. in Mississauga, Ontario.
•   - PGA Tour: The TOUR Championship, First Round at 10 a.m. in Atlanta.
•   - DP World Tour: The Betfred British Masters, First Round at 11 p.m. (Friday) in Sutton Coldfield, England (Taped).
• Horse Racing:
•   - NYRA: Saratoga Live at 10 a.m. on FS2.
•   - NYRA: Saratoga Live at 2 p.m. on FS1.
• Little League Baseball:
•   - International Semifinal at 12 p.m. on ESPN.
•   - U.S. Semifinal at 4 p.m. on ESPN.
• Mixed Martial Arts: 2025 PFL World Tournament - Finals at 6 p.m. on ESPN.
• MLB Baseball:
•   - Regional Coverage: Milwaukee at Chicago Cubs at 11 a.m. on MLBN.
•   - Regional Coverage: San Francisco at San Diego at 2:30 p.m. on MLBN.
•   - Regional Coverage: Boston at N.Y. Yankees at 4 p.m. on FOX.
• NFL Football: Preseason Pittsburgh at Carolina at 4 p.m. on NFLN.
• NFL Football: Preseason New England at N.Y. Giants at 5 p.m. on PRIME VIDEO.
• Rugby (Men's): NRL: St. George Illawarra at South Sydney at 2:45 a.m. on FS2.
• Rugby (Men's): 2025 MLR Draft at 3 p.m. on ESPNU.
• Soccer (Women's): NWSL: Orlando at Angel City at 7:30 p.m. on CBSSN.
• Softball: Athletes Unlimited All-Star Cup at 4 p.m. on ESPNU.
• Tennis: ATP/WTA: The U.S. Open - Qualifying, Third Round at 8 a.m. on ESPN2.
• Tennis: ATP/WTA: The U.S. Open - Qualifying, Third Round at 10 a.m. on ESPNEWS.
• WNBA Basketball: Chicago at New York at 4 p.m. on PRIME VIDEO.
• WNBA Basketball: Phoenix at Las Vegas at 7 p.m. on PRIME VIDEO.
